name: Equinix SG1
notes: Equinix IBX SG1 at 20 Ayer Rajah Crescent, one-north Central Xchange (Ayer Rajah industrial park), 13 MW power per directory. Carrier-hotel hub of Singapore. Assigned to Central Singapore CDC per methodology one-north/Ayer Rajah seed; boundary check recommended (Queenstown planning area).

name: Equinix SG3
notes: Equinix SG3 at 26A Ayer Rajah Crescent; largest Equinix data center in Asia-Pacific at opening (2015, ~35,000 m2 colocation space, ~5,000 cabinets at full build-out). Same Ayer Rajah campus as SG1; Central Singapore CDC (division_check_needed).

name: STT Singapore 1/2/3 (STT Defu Campus)
capacity_notes: Defu 1 and 2 at 12 MW each + Defu 3 at 15 MW = 39-40 MW campus IT load
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC)
notes: STT GDC flagship Defu campus (23 Defu Avenue 1, Hougang area): STT Singapore 1 and 2 operational at 12 MW each; STT Defu 3 announced April 2021, operational 2022, 15 MW, 7 storeys, 156,000 sq ft. Total ~39-40 MW. Assigned North East CDC (Defu/Hougang) - methodology flags NE/SE boundary verification.

name: Keppel DC Singapore 1 (KDC SGP1)
notes: KDC SGP1: six-storey DC plus five-storey annexe, 225,956 sq ft GFA, in Serangoon North Industrial Estate ~10.5 km from city centre (North East). Keppel official site and Keppel DC REIT portfolio page; GIS-verified North East per methodology.

name: Global Switch Woodlands
notes: Global Switch Singapore Woodlands at 7 Woodlands Height (Singapore 737858), 22 MW per Global Switch official site, ~25,157 m2 floor area; AWS Direct Connect and Google Cloud on-net. North West CDC.

name: Keppel DC Singapore DC1 (KDC DC1)
notes: Keppel DC DC1 located in Woodlands (North West) per methodology known-facilities table; Keppel official Singapore locations page confirms presence. Capacity not stated on cited page.

name: AirTrunk SGP1
capacity_notes: Opened 2020 with 30 MW first phase; 60+ MW full build-out; design PUE 1.25
notes: AirTrunk SGP1 at 22 Loyang Drive, Pasir Ris (Loyang area, 1.5 ha, 20,000 sqm white space), near Changi North Cable Landing Station; opened 2020 as Singapore's largest independent hyperscale DC; 60+ MW at full build-out. South East CDC per methodology.

name: Global Switch Tai Seng
notes: Global Switch Singapore Tai Seng at 2 Tai Seng Avenue (Singapore 534408), 17 MW per methodology (directory sources cite 25-30 MW); 7-storey, ~287,000 sq ft; key interconnection point near financial district and subsea cable landings; BBIX Singapore No.3 IXP hosted here. South East CDC.

name: Keppel DC Singapore 2/3/4 (KDC SGP2-4)
notes: Keppel DC SGP2 (25 Tampines Street 92), SGP3 (27 Tampines Street 92) and SGP4 located in Tampines Industrial Park, eastern Singapore; carrier-neutral Tier 3 colocation, operational. South East CDC per methodology.

name: Digital Realty SIN11 (Digital Loyang)
notes: Digital Realty SIN11 at 3 Loyang Way, 177,000 sq ft, Tier III, 13.2 MW critical IT capacity (Digital Realty official). Loyang/Pasir Ris area - assigned South East CDC (division_check_needed; close to AirTrunk SGP1).

name: Equinix SG4
notes: Equinix SG4 at 7 Tai Seng Drive, east Singapore; fills geographic gap in Equinix footprint (Structure Research); operational colocation. Tai Seng area - South East CDC (same district as Global Switch Tai Seng).

name: Equinix SG2
notes: Equinix SG2 at 15 Pioneer Walk, Jurong (west Singapore), operational IBX; Epsilon fiber network extends to Equinix SG2/SG3 and Digital Realty (DCD). South West CDC.

name: Equinix SG5
notes: Equinix SG5 at 6 Sunview Drive, Tanjong Kling data center park, Jurong; opened 2021; nine-storey, Singapore's tallest multi-tenant DC; first phase ~3,970 m2 / 1,300 cabinets. PeeringDB facility 10725. South West CDC.

name: Equinix SG6
notes: Equinix SG6 at Jalan Tukang, Jurong: nine-storey AI-ready facility, 20 MW at full build-out, US$260m investment, opening expected Q1 2027; awarded capacity under IMDA pilot DC-CFA (per methodology). South West CDC.

name: Digital Realty SIN10 (Digital Jurong)
notes: Digital Realty SIN10 at 29A International Business Park, Jurong East; seven-storey, ~377,000 sq ft; 2N UPS and N+2 cooling (operational since 2018). Digital Realty official page. South West CDC.

name: Nxera DC Tuas
notes: Nxera DC Tuas (Tuas, South West): 58 MW AI-ready IT load, 8 storeys, 120,000 sq ft, PUE 1.25, BCA Green Mark Platinum, highest power-density DC in Singapore; opened Feb 2026 (Singtel official release); brings Nxera Singapore capacity to 120 MW.

name: DayOne SG1
notes: DayOne SG1 at 21 Jalan Buroh, Jurong industrial estate (Boon Lay area): ~39,980 sqm GFA (3-storey warehouse + 7-storey office block), 20 MW capacity, target RFS 2027; property acquired from CapitaLand (2024, GDS-related); hydrogen SOFC pilot planned per methodology. South West CDC.

name: Keppel DC Singapore 5 (KDC SGP5)
notes: Keppel DC SGP5 located in Jurong (South West) per methodology known-facilities table; Keppel official Singapore locations page confirms. Capacity not stated on cited page.

name: ST Engineering Data Centre@Boon Lay
notes: ST Engineering's fourth data centre, at Jalan Boon Lay (within ST Engineering Land Systems premises): groundbreaking 25 June 2024, ~S$120m investment, seven-storey 6,000 sq ft facility, AI-ready, PUE 1.25 design, solar facade, target operational 2026 (MTI speech + ST). South West CDC.
